headline: PSOE Presents Its Electoral Programme: Will Allocate 1% of GDP to Affordable Housing and Spend 19,000 Million on Railway Lines
summary: Spain's PSOE presented an electoral programme that would allocate 1% of GDP to affordable housing and 19,000 million euros to railway lines. It also promises 100,000 public homes.
why: Public housing and rail spending plans affect construction demand and the government's fiscal path.
